[[File:IARserieslocomotion.jpg|thumb|The Industrial Automaton R-Family Locomotion Unit]]
'''R-Family Locomotion Unit''' was a treaded locomotion part for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with large [[Battery/Legends|battery]] capacity and medium power usage made by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]].
It was equipped with a telescoping arm. However, as with most treaded locomotion units, it could'nt jump.
R-Family Locomotion Units were made of [[Silicon/Legends|silicon]], [[Aluminium/Legends|aluminium]] and [[Carbon/Legends|low-carbon]] [[Steel/Legends|steel]], which allowed them to be magnetic. Those locomotion units had average durability and weighed 45.0 kg.

R-Family Locomotions Units were quite familiar in the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] as they were part of the [[R-series/Legends|successful R-series astromech droids]], up until the creation of the [[R7-series astromech droid|R7 units]].
